## Functional verification complete

I3 functionality now includes:

- exact Investor Account and symbol-slot mapping;
- packed TMP Side `01/02` to normalized BUY/SELL conversion;
- configurable OrdType/TIF/PositionEffect policy and kill-switch fail-closed behavior;
- atomic futures RESERVE followed by AMU context INSERT;
- duplicate/full AMU failure with exact RELEASE rollback;
- accounting reject before store mutation;
- explicit injected rollback-failure escalation that never accepts;
- accepted original 256-bit payload held bit-for-bit unchanged;
- stable result under downstream backpressure;
- CI compile-smoke of the I3 physical composition.

## I3-04 remaining physical gate

Prepared local command:

```powershell
pwsh .\scripts\run_i3_cl2ex_ooc_impl.ps1
```

The OOC top composes:

```text
frozen-HFT 256-bit order boundary
  + integration account/product maps
  + adapter and fail-closed policy
  + atomic CL2EX admission controller
  + pipelined futures state manager
  + real pinned RMIC XPM 8-bank AMU order store
```

Acceptance requires real BRAM use, complete route, WNS >= 0 ns at 6.400 ns, TNS = 0, zero routing errors, and reviewed utilization/DRC/power/critical-path evidence.

## Prior closed evidence

I2 already closed the futures state + execution composition at routed WNS `+1.078 ns`, TNS `0`, with 19 RAMB36 + 1 RAMB18, 10 DSP and zero routing errors. I3 specifically measures the incremental CL2EX mapping/policy/atomic-admission path.

## Claim limit

I3 functional correctness is established by self-checking CI. I3 post-route closure is not established until its local Vivado package is reviewed. Full frozen-HFT R01 insertion, full HFT+RMIC latency, board packet latency, TAIFEX SPAN, network/PHY migration and live exchange behavior remain later phases.
